facts.fact: The document says a proposed activity-based authorisation framework for non-banks performing payment activities is still being developed, with the draft in industry engagement and piloting and release expected in the first quarter of 2027 (Standard Bank's Nthabiseng Mohale).

ZAF.note: Fraud and compliance requirements are mentioned for licensees; no consumer-protection rule or redress stated.

facts.fact: The document says Transactions Cleared on an Immediate Basis (TCIB) is being developed to enable immediate low-value cross-border payments in the region.
Standard Bank's Nthabiseng Sibanda says the bank uses China's CIPS as a direct route for renminbi transactions, reaching 12 African countries.
Standard Bank's Nthabiseng Sibanda says the bank has processed more than R21 billion ($1.3 billion) through CIPS since its inception.

ZAF.note: No government payment to people stated.
The document covers clearing institutions and rules, not a retail service in service.
No tax or fee payment stated.
